learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to (Reading) read and understand easy texts.
(Writing) write letters with simple sentences, and introduce themselves and others.
(Listening and Speaking) listen to and understand beginner-level daily conversations; introduce and express themselves and others with simple sentences.
(Vocabulary) recognize and use beginner-level vocabulary related to daily life.
Technology Use: They will acquire independent study skills by completing internet assignments given via technology and can access all course materials through Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Unit 13: Strawberries are expensive. Singular and plural forms of food sold in the market.
Unit 14: It's expensive because it's Italian. Singular and plural forms of clothes sold in the market.
Unit 15: I will go to the bank to withdraw money. Giving information about future actions.
Unit 16: What shall we eat? Ordering food in a restaurant.
Unit 17: An apartment near the center. Types of houses, floors, interior plans. Cardinal Numbers (1-20). Staying in a hotel: Giving/receiving information during check-in/check-out.

Unit 18: Plaka 
— a neighborhood in Athens (reading passage). General review (additional exercises prepared for the review of units 13-17).
Unit 19: We must leave early. Subjunctive mood (conjugations of all verb types). Speaking on the phone. Politely asking for something (I would like a cup of coffee, I would like to ask, etc.).
Unit 20: We went to Knossos on Tuesday. Giving information about past actions. Correspondence. Simple Past Tense.
Unit 21: The climate of Attica is good. Weather, seasons, and months. Expressing good wishes.
Unit 22: The first one is taller than the second. Comparing, describing, and giving opinions about people. Comparative and superlative adjectives. Sending a letter from the post office.

Unit 23: If you leave before eleven, you will find him there. Type 1 conditional sentences (expression of reality-based assumptions). 2nd person singular and 2nd person plural imperative moods (conjugations of come, go, exit, wait, sit verbs). Indefinite pronouns.
